orientation: rotation 0: the ram faces UP (place it on the hull edge and turn it outward, as a mount)
notes: Scrapper "Battering Bow" (ram, scrap, 4x2): a wedge of welded girders pointing UP: a heavy base beam bolted along the bottom, two raking girders (one steel, one rust) and a king post meeting at a battered ram head; dark ram-plate armour with big bolt heads fills the wedge (the walls_ram plating); the head carries the amber-and-black hazard tape on its leading edge, as ram plating does, and two hooked latch claws (it latches on to what it hits), drawn by a chain from a winch at the base. The nose is a solid steel point. Unpowered: the on loop is only its amber lamp blinking. Damaged: the left claw bent back, a weld on the rust girder cracked open, the head dented deeper and scorched. Disabled: the head knocked askew, the rust girder snapped at its weld, the right claw broken off and lying on the plate, the chain slack.
